subject: Aurora site-week: demo timing during their travel week
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@aurorahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial demo follow-up — site visit week conflict

Hi Grace —

Quick heads-up: our team will be traveling the week of Sept 6 for an on-site facility review and several of the decision makers will be out of town. We still want to see the Redwood walkthrough, but the schedule is tight.

Options we can consider (from my side):
- Move the demo to earlier that week (Mon/Tue morning PT) before the bulk of travel starts
- Record a condensed demo that we watch asynchronously and then do a 30-minute live Q&A while some folks are on-site
- Push the full demo to the following week (Sept 13) when everyone is back — less ideal because procurement is trying to accelerate timelines

Attached is our site-week itinerary so you can see when folks are actually in the office. Can you let me know what would work? We have two primary stakeholders: Dr. Marcus Alvarez (clinical lead) and Priya Rao (procurement).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Li
Director, Clinical Operations
Aurora Health

Attachments: site-week-itinerary.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo follow-up — site visit week conflict

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing the itinerary — that helps a lot. We can absolutely accommodate the site-week constraints. Quick proposal:

1) If you can do a short slot early in the week, we can run a 40-minute targeted demo focused on throughput, latency, and on-prem deployment patterns.
2) If the group prefers asynchronous, we can send a 12-minute recorded demo (condensed) + a 30-minute live Q&A at a time that overlaps with your on-site schedule.
3) If neither works, we can push to the week of Sept 13 as a backup, but agree that would slow procurement.

I've attached a slimmed demo deck that maps sections to stakeholder interests (clinical / security / procurement) so you can share it with Dr. Alvarez and Priya ahead of time. If option 2 looks best, tell me two 30-minute slots that overlap on your side and we'll lock the Q&A.

Also looping Karthik — he can cover the more technical system-level questions if needed and is flexible for early-morning PT times.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Aurora-demo-deck-v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo follow-up — site visit week conflict

Grace / Hannah —

I can do live coverage for the technical portion if you pick Mon/Tue early slots. Specifically I have availability:
- Mon Sept 6, 10:00–11:00 PT (can compress to a 40-minute tech-focused window)
- Tue Sept 7, 08:30–09:30 PT (earlier, can be quieter for us)

If you go with the recorded + Q&A, I can prerecord the system deep-dive and be available for the Q&A during either of the 30-minute overlap windows Grace suggested.

Also happy to include short notes on on-prem network requirements and a slide on quantization/cost tradeoffs for Priya's procurement review.

—Karthik
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@aurorahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial demo follow-up — site visit week conflict

Hi Grace / Karthik —

Thanks — option 2 (recorded + 30-minute live Q&A) sounds best for our group. Most of the execs will be on-site but will have short pockets between meetings. Could we do the following?

- You send the recorded demo by EOD Monday (Sept 6)
- Live Q&A: Tue Sept 7 at 08:45–09:15 PT (this overlaps with our on-site break)
- Please include a 1-page agenda for the Q&A and call out who will cover procurement/security/technical bits (so Priya knows what to expect)
- We'll circulate the deck to Dr. Marcus Alvarez and Priya Rao before Monday

Grace — can you also confirm if a short on-site white-glove setup is possible (someone from Redwood to join us on-site for a quick 20–30 minute consult)? If that requires procurement approvals, Priya can loop in the right person after the Q&A.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the recording.

Best,
Hannah
